intro_html: Taco-seasoned turkey simmered in salsa with peppers and onions, piled on rice with black beans, melted cheese, and cilantro. Each bowl carries 33 grams of protein for about $2.40. Same idea as the $12 chain bowl, minus the $12.
cost_closing_html: About $2.40 a bowl for a burrito bowl the fast casual chains price at $12 before extras. Fourteen of these cost less than three of theirs.
shop_smart: Jarred salsa is the flavor engine at $5.18, and it replaces tomatoes, chiles, and half your spice rack in one pour. Store brand jars on sale drop it further.
The 4 lb pack of 93/7 ground turkey is the price-per-pound winner, and this recipe uses 3.75 lb of it, so nothing lingers in the fridge.
Seasoned black beans at about a dollar a can add protein and fiber for pennies a bowl. Stock up when they dip below a dollar.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Cook the rice: rinse, simmer covered with water until tender, and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in your biggest skillet. Cook the diced red onion and green bell peppers until soft, about 6 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the ground turkey and break it up as it browns. Cook to 165F with no pink remaining, then stir in the taco seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Pour in the salsa and simmer 8 to 10 minutes until it thickens into a saucy taco filling.
Stir in the drained black beans and heat through.
Portion rice into 14 containers, top with the turkey mixture, then finish with cheese and chopped cilantro.
portion_html: Weigh the rice pot and the skillet, subtract the empty pot number, and divide each by 14 so every container gets an even share. Each bowl comes out to about 574 calories and 33 grams of protein.

steps: Cook the rice and set aside.
Cook red onion and bell peppers in olive oil, add garlic, then brown the turkey to 165F with taco seasoning.
Add salsa and simmer until thick, then stir in the black beans.
Portion rice into 14 containers and top with turkey, cheese, and cilantro.
